title: A storage texture
blurb: An image a compute entry writes by texel coordinate, with no sampler and no filtering (§33). The format and the access mode are part of the type, as they are in WGSL, and are written as string literal types so `tsc` checks a mistyped format in the editor. Three bindings: one `"write"`, one `"read_write"` at `"r32float"` (the only formats a device reads and writes through one binding), and one integer format whose texel is a `vec4u`. A storage texture in a draw is not supported yet by the GLSL backend (Rule 10.5); in a compute entry it runs on WebGL2 through the pass program (Rule 10.5). Two things it refuses that Tint does not, because Tint compiles a shader and a device binds one.
